title: Analytical finite-rank oracle for one-dimensional defect bound states
status_detail: Proposed third follow-on after independent-route verification. No finite-rank resolvent oracle or independently checked analytical bound-state result is active, calculated, or accepted.
objective: Construct an exactly or independently solvable finite-rank defect whose bound-state energies and subspaces provide analytical oracles for the numerical extraction and spectral machinery.
authorized_scope: Plan rank-one and, when bounded and useful, low-rank Hermitian defects on the accepted scalar or two-orbital one-dimensional represented parent.
Derive bound-state conditions from an independently evaluated resolvent, determinant, or equivalent finite-rank identity without reproducing the eigensolver under test.
Compare analytical energies, bound-state counts, projectors or isolated-state fidelities, and extracted operators under declared finite-size and representation conventions.
completion_criteria: At least one nontrivial finite-rank defect has an explicit analytical or independently evaluated spectral condition with a declared domain and root-selection rule.
Numerical bound-state energies and equal-rank subspaces agree with the oracle within frozen tolerances over a bounded parameter and supercell sequence.
Threshold, degeneracy, unequal-rank, and no-bound-state cases retain explicit outcomes, provenance, and limitations.
exclusions: A numerical diagonalization duplicated in different syntax is not an analytical oracle.
Agreement with the finite-rank oracle does not establish a continuum limit, material impurity model, scientific validation, or uncertainty quantification.
No material calculation, external execution, dependency change, or public API freeze is authorized.
